statement: Vishakha's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Jupiter; its presiding deity is Indra and Agni (twin deities), symbolized by a triumphal archway. It is traditionally associated with focused purpose and determined achievement, pursuing a goal with steady intensity.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
